name: Beires (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly, green above and yellow below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Beires (a bridge with a shovel and a mallet on green).
history: Beires applied to the Junta de Andalucía on 20 July 2005 to register the arms and flag in use, receiving approval in February 2009; the flag is described as a rectangular cloth one and a half times longer than wide, parted by a diagonal, green above and yellow below.

features.role: Beires arms — bridge, shovel and mallet on green
